Oink 0.1.4 adds Mac-style scrolling on Windows, refines auto-compact and fixes a drag-and-drop issue.

## New

- New Windows setting "Emulate Mac trackpad scrolling": when a Mac trackpad controls the PC, two-finger scrolling feels like it does on the Mac.
- Auto-compact now moves only the computer you just adjusted and stops where it touches another computer; hidden screens no longer affect the layout.

## Fixes

- Fixed files not dragging to another computer from the bottom edge of a Mac's external display.

## Downloads

- **Mac:** the `.dmg` file — Apple silicon, macOS 14.2 or later. Developer ID signed and notarized.
- **Windows:** the `.msi` file — x64, Windows 10 22H2 (build 19045) or later, or Windows 11. Requires the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Evergreen runtime (preinstalled on current Windows).

Verify downloads against `SHA256SUMS`.

## Known limitations

- The Windows MSI is not code-signed in this release. SmartScreen may say "Windows protected your PC": choose **More info → Run anyway**. UAC shows an unknown publisher.
